author: Diego Sandoval
title: Ranger Suarez leaves Sunday's start early
desc: Ranger Suarez left Sunday's game against the Angels with a trainer in the third inning.
impact: Suarez appeared to be shaking his leg as he came off the field, but the exact nature and extent of the injury are currently unknown. Greg Weissert entered the game to replace Suarez.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Jonah Heim drives in six in loss to Marlins
desc: Jonah Heim went 2-for-4 in a loss to the Marlins with a home run, one run scored, and six RBI.
impact: Heim continues a steady stretch at the plate, collecting hits in seven of his last 10 contests. The 31-year-old remains one of many streaky options in the Athletics lineup for manager Mark Kotsay, slashing .241 with nine home runs, 29 RBI, and 20 runs scored through 46 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Gage Jump shelled early in loss to Marlins
desc: Gage Jump allowed six earned runs on eight hits and three walks while striking out one over three innings in Sunday's 9-8 loss to the Marlins.
impact: Jump has provided mixed results on the mound, allowing three earned runs or more in four of eight contests. The left-hander remains one of many inconsistent options in the Athletics rotation to this point, posting a 3.98 ERA and 1.30 WHIP with a 3-3 record and 8.6 K/9 ratio through eight starts.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Jake Bauers goes yard in win over Diamondbacks
desc: Jake Bauers went 1-for-4 in a win over the Diamondbacks with a two-run home run.
impact: Bauers has offered mixed results at the plate of late, recording hits in six of his last 11 contests. The 30-year-old continues to flash an explosive bat as one of the more streaky options in the Brewers lineup for manager Pat Murphy, carrying an .861 OPS with 16 home runs, 54 RBI, 51 runs scored, and five stolen bases through 79 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Trevor Megill shuts door for save in win over Diamondbacks
desc: Trevor Megill allowed one walk over one scoreless inning to earn the save in Sunday's 3-2 win over the Diamondbacks.
impact: Megill continues an impressive stretch out of the bullpen, holding opponents scoreless in each of his last 12 contests. The right-hander has returned to form as a reliable closer option out of the Brewers bullpen for manager Pat Murphy, posting a 3.09 ERA and 0.97 WHIP with a 2-2 record, seven holds, 13 saves, and 11.3 K/9 ratio across 36 appearances.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Brandon Sproat grinds through traffic in no-decision
desc: Brandon Sproat allowed one earned run on five hits and three walks while striking out four over four innings in Sunday's win over the Diamondbacks.
impact: Sproat continues a solid stretch on the mound of late, allowing two earned runs or less in four of his last six contests. The right-hander continues to turn around an underwhelming start to the season in the Brewers rotation for manager Pat Murphy, posting a 5.13 ERA and 1.37 WHIP with a 3-4 record and 9.6 K/9 ratio across 17 appearances.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Rafael Devers goes yard twice in loss to Rockies
desc: Rafael Devers went 2-for-5 in Sunday's loss to the Rockies with two solo home runs.
impact: Devers continues a scorching stretch at the plate, picking up hits in 11 of his last 12 contests. The 29-year-old has frustrated fantasy managers as one of many inconsistent bats in the Giants lineup, slashing .248 with 18 home runs, 47 RBI, and 43 runs scored through 89 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Casey Schmitt goes deep in loss to Rockies
desc: Casey Schmitt went 1-for-4 in a loss to the Rockies with a solo home run.
impact: Schmitt has provided mixed results at the plate of late, recording hits in four of his last eight contests. The 27-year-old remains one of the more streaky options in the Giants lineup for manager Tony Vitello, posting an .806 OPS with 17 home runs, 45 RBI, 39 runs scored, and seven stolen bases across 81 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Drew Gilbert racks up four hits in loss to Rockies
desc: Drew Gilbert went 4-for-4 in Sunday's loss to the Rockies with a home run, one double, one run scored, and three RBI.
impact: Gilbert continues an underwhelming stretch at the plate, collecting hits in two of his last nine contests. The outfielder remains one of many inconsistent options in the Giants lineup to this point, hitting .243 with four home runs, 19 RBI, and 42 runs scored through 70 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Tyler Mahle labors on mound in shortened outing
desc: Tyler Mahle allowed four runs (three earned) on eight hits while striking out five over 4 1/3 innings in Sunday's loss to the Rockies.
impact: Mahle has struggled to miss opposing bats of late, allowing three earned runs or more in six of his last seven trips to the mound. The right-hander remains one of the more underwhelming options in the Giants rotation for manager Tony Vitello, posting a 5.70 ERA and 1.49 WHIP with a 1-8 record and 2.38 K/BB ratio through 14 starts.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Triston Casas (wrist) shut down from hitting
desc: Triston Casas had a wrist issue pop up recently and has been shut down from hitting.
impact: Casas has not played at any level during the 2026 season due to knee and abdominal injuries, and he has now picked up a wrist injury. The 26-year-old's rest-of-season outlook is most definitely murky as his injuries begin to pile up.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Kyle Karros goes deep in win over Giants
desc: Kyle Karros went 1-for-4 in Sunday's 7-6 win over the Giants with a three-run home run.
impact: Karros continues a scorching stretch at the plate, recording hits in 11 of his last 13 contests. The 23-year-old offers manager Warren Schaeffer one of the more impactful options in the Rockies lineup, slashing .263 with seven home runs, 29 RBI, 44 runs scored, and three stolen bases through 86 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: TJ Rumfield picks up three hits in win over Giants
desc: TJ Rumfield went 3-for-4 in Sunday's win over the Giants with one double and two runs scored.
impact: Rumfield continues a torrid stretch at the plate, picking up hits in 17 of his last 18 contests. The 26-year-old offers manager Warren Schaeffer one of the more consistent options in the Rockies lineup, posting an .874 OPS with 12 home runs, 47 RBI, and 42 runs scored across 88 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Jordan Romano shuts door for save in win over Giants
desc: Jordan Romano allowed one hit while striking out two over one scoreless inning to record the save in Sunday's 7-6 win over the Giants.
impact: Romano is off to a solid start out of the bullpen since arriving in Colorado, holding opponents scoreless in each of his two trips to the mound. The right-hander remains difficult to trust until he offers more evidence of reliability moving forward, posting an 8.10 ERA and 1.90 WHIP with an 0-2 record, five saves, and a 2.67 K/BB ratio through 13 appearances.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Tanner Gordon torched early in no-decision
desc: Tanner Gordon allowed five earned runs on six hits and two walks while striking out seven over five innings in Sunday's win over the Giants.
impact: Gordon continues a dismal stretch on the mound of late, allowing four earned runs or more in three of his last four contests. The right-hander cannot be trusted as a reliable starting option in an underwhelming Rockies rotation, posting a 6.95 ERA and 1.59 WHIP with an 0-2 record and 9.1 K/9 ratio through 11 appearances.
